about: Calibration data for a FICTIONAL animated story. Derived from public Solana data about a publicly reported allegation by an analytics firm; OUR ESTIMATES only. Timing, clustering and funding links do not prove common ownership or intent. No wallet addresses, token mints, tickers, handles or names are included.

units.t: seconds relative to the public wallet's first buy of the token (t=0)
units.price: pool price divided by the pool price of the public wallet's first buy (public buy = 1.0)
units.volume_usd: quote volume traded on the pool in the 5-second bucket, converted to USD with an on-chain quote-token reference, rounded to $10
units.tx_listed: exact number of successful pool transactions in the bucket (from the pool's signature list)
units.candle: 5-second OHLC; empty buckets are flat at the previous close (empty=true)

validation: every candle passes high >= max(open, close), low <= min(open, close), prices > 0

event_labels.public: the trader's public wallet (a buy or sell, rounded USD)
event_labels.launch_cluster_wallet: a wallet that bought in the token's first ~35 s (our detection; NOT a confirmed side wallet; NOT the analytics firm's set)
event_labels.seller_proceeds_to_third_address: a sell whose proceeds were paid to an address other than the seller (relay pattern seen in this case)

audit_summary.status: OUR ESTIMATE from public Solana data about an analytics firm's allegation. Not a finding about any person. Timing, clustering and funding links do not prove common ownership or intent. Checker-corrected.
audit_summary.claim_summary: A social trader's public wallet showed a five-figure USD loss on several promoted launchpad tokens while 'connected' wallets showed a gain several times larger; dozens of fresh wallets bought each token at similar times with about 0.5-1% of supply each; the public wallet was said to be linked to the token deployers through intermediary wallets (exact figures withheld: they identify the case).

public_wallet.pays_with: USD stablecoin through an app router (a relayer paid network fees)
public_wallet.behaviour: kept adding as the price rose (up to 1.5-7.5x its first buy price), then sold days to weeks later 83-96% below its average entry (one position still held)

D4.pnl_note: route subset only; not re-estimated for the full launch
D4.share_of_supply_note: acquired within ~35 s of creation, excluding the deployer's own creation-transaction buy

D3.pnl_note: deployer's own ~50% creation-transaction stake, sold within ~26 min (~$27K), plus the relay set (~$6.5K, stratified)
D3.share_of_supply_note: acquired within ~35 s of creation, excluding the deployer's own creation-transaction buy

D2.pnl_note: deployer's own ~50% creation-transaction stake, sold within ~27 min (~$43K), plus the relay set (~$12K, stratified)
D2.share_of_supply_note: acquired within ~35 s of creation, excluding the deployer's own creation-transaction buy

patterns_seen: Three of the four deployer wallets were created 2-4 minutes before launch and funded by three same-second transfers of identical size, from wallets funded the same way (a multi-layer split); the fourth token was created by a launchpad's own account.
One launch: 80 wallets bought in a single block about 6 seconds after creation, each spending the same small amount on fees and account rent.
Launch clusters were large: 50-100 wallets per token took at least 0.1% of supply within ~35 s of creation (up to 80 in one block).

Two launches' creation transactions included the deployer's own buy of about half the supply; the deployers sold those stakes within ~26-27 minutes, paid to the same collectors as the relay wallets. Other wallets bought 10% and 20% in the same slot and passed them on within seconds.

Launch wallets mostly sold within about 5-45 minutes of creation; in the sampled sales up to 99% of each sale's proceeds went to an address other than the seller (one or two collectors per token, or one paired address per wallet).
In the minute of the public wallet's first buy, pool activity was about 63x, 43x and 7x the average of the previous 10 minutes on three tokens (about 2x on the fourth).
audit_summary.funding_links: No transaction shared between the public wallet (its full history, April to November 2026) and any of 73 examined deployer, funder and launch-cluster wallets. One weak link: the public wallet's first deposit came from a busy service-like address (thousands of transactions a day) that also funded 4 of 20 sampled launch-burst wallets of one token; such addresses fund many unrelated users. The claimed two-step link to the deployers could not be reproduced within our budget.
